_what: A pre-registered refusal of the one failure this reproduction has already had, written at step ~175 of leg 2 when no reading past it existed and committed so the timestamp is git's.
_why_these_references: Leg 1 ran 1451 steps from an all-zero init in which 356 of 436 parameters had an identically zero gradient, so it measured where a model that trains nothing sits. Its settled region (steps 1052-1451, n=400) is the void reference. The leg-2 reference is this leg's own position at steps 75-174 (n=100), so the bar also refuses a run that climbs back toward the void after leaving it.
_not_an_accuracy_bar: Clearing this says the run is not degenerate. It says nothing about CDR-H3. The accuracy bars are unchanged and not renegotiable: step 5805 -> mean CDR-H3 <= 4.12 A, step 19351 -> <= 3.46 A, on the 150 validation structures.
_phase: Measured through the shipped scheduler at steps_per_epoch 132: lr is 99.83 % of peak at step 174, 83.91 % at 1735, 80.27 % at 1935 and 36.62 % at 3870, all inside the first cosine cycle of 6600. The comparison runs from higher lr to lower, which is the direction that helps a loss, so a FAIL cannot be blamed on schedule phase. A PASS is correspondingly not evidence of anything beyond not-degenerate.
_units: loss values from the history rows, not the loss_terms wall clock. loss = fape + supervised_chi + 0.5 * final_output_backbone, recovered by least squares over 66 steps with max residual 3.7e-07.
on_fail: The leg stops and reports without waiting for step 5805. A run that is not measurably below the coordinates a zero model occupies, at 1 % of the schedule, has found the same flat region.
